validated_result.semantic_rationale: The downstream recruiter_summary_agent must produce a structured report that includes a candidate identifier and any items that trigger human review. Those two pieces of information are explicitly required by the consumer schema (candidate_overview, review_issues). All other fields supplied by the screening_review_agent provide context that can be folded into higher‑level flags or transformed into the consumer's "inconsistencies", "criteria_matrix", and "validation_warnings" sections. Because the consumer does not declare those fields verbatim, they are marked as uncertain rather than redundant – they may be valuable for scoring or for generating explanatory text. A compact payload replaces the six original fields with a minimal set of primitives and a nested "summary_flags" object, reducing payload size while preserving every semantic element needed for downstream synthesis.

additional_optimization_opportunities.title: Fast-Path Early Exit for Standard/Compliant Artifacts
additional_optimization_opportunities.observed_problem: The target workflow runs through all 8 stages sequentially regardless of input complexity or deviation status. Standard contracts or clean inputs that pass initial verification without issues still execute all downstream remediation and deep analysis loops, consuming ~44.8s.
additional_optimization_opportunities.proposed_solution: Introduce a fast-path conditional checkpoint: if zero high-risk ambiguities or compliance deviations are identified in early stages, bypass extensive multi-agent reconciliation and jump directly to final report generation.

expected_benefit.quality_impact: Maintains strict rigor by restricting fast-path to zero-deviation verified cases.

tradeoffs_and_risks.latency_tradeoff: Over 50% latency reduction on clean input distributions.
tradeoffs_and_risks.token_cost_tradeoff: Cuts token spend in half for routine standard cases.
